verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs show an organization can hold multiple depository (checking/savings) accounts and move money between them via internal transfers. Automatic allocation of deposits is backed only by a long-time customer's report of 'dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules', with no first-party documentation of the rules. The FDIC sweep network spreads deposits across partner banks, not across user sub-accounts, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of opening multiple checking sub-accounts, documented auto-allocation or percentage-split rules for incoming deposits, and API or configuration details for those rules.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them

citations.quote: Transfer funds between two accounts within the same organization. Supports transfers between depository accounts (checking/savings)
